description: The image features a series of concentric circles centered around a small blue dot, with the largest circle positioned to the left and the smallest circle positioned to the right. A horizontal line intersects the vertical axis at the center of the circles, extending from the left edge to the right edge of the image. A diagonal line starts from the center of the circles and extends to the right, intersecting the largest circle. The background is white, and the lines and circles are drawn in black.

Two distinct sections labeled (a) and (b) are positioned side by side. Section (a) features a circular diagram with multiple concentric circles, each outlined in a light gray color, creating a grid-like pattern. A prominent blue spiral starts from the center and expands outward, following the curvature of the concentric circles. The spiral is thicker and more defined compared to the grid lines. Section (b) displays a realistic image of a snail shell. The shell has a spiral shape with alternating bands of brown and cream colors, giving it a natural, textured appearance. The spiral starts from the center and widens as it moves outward, mirroring the pattern seen in section (a). The background of both sections is plain white, emphasizing the details of the diagrams and the shell.
